scenarios.title: Simple conversation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Ordered start/delta/completed events and persisted messages.
scenarios.verification: Inspect SSE order and conversation detail.

scenarios.title: Conversation isolation
scenarios.purpose: Prevent goal or message state leaking across conversations.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Each conversation retains only its own state and messages.
scenarios.verification: Compare both conversation details and linked goal IDs.

scenarios.title: Memory retrieval after restart
scenarios.trigger: Restart process and ask for the stored fact.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Relevant persisted memory is retrieved without unrelated content.
scenarios.verification: Restart-backed integration assertion.

scenarios.title: Remembered decision retrieval
scenarios.purpose: Retrieve a prior decision with provenance.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Correct decision and provenance are returned.
scenarios.verification: Compare sanitized memory result to seeded decision.

scenarios.title: Project context answer
scenarios.expected_outcome: Answer uses targeted project evidence.
scenarios.verification: Assert expected symbols and no unrelated paths.

scenarios.title: Filesystem read
scenarios.purpose: Read an allowed UTF-8 file safely.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exact content hash is verified.
scenarios.verification: Compare content and SHA-256.

scenarios.title: Write and exact readback
scenarios.trigger: Request a file with exact content and approve.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Write and exact readback reach completed_verified.
scenarios.verification: Read file independently and compare exact bytes.

scenarios.title: Git status observation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Structured status matches git porcelain.
scenarios.verification: Compare bounded fields to fixture state.

scenarios.title: Repeated identical goal
scenarios.purpose: Ensure completed work is not accidentally replayed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Second run is independently bounded and no prior goal is resumed.
scenarios.verification: Compare goal IDs, actions and file effects.

scenarios.title: Anti-spin no progress
scenarios.expected_outcome: Goal becomes blocked within hard limits.
scenarios.verification: Assert bounded replans and failed steps.

scenarios.title: Malformed planner output
scenarios.purpose: Reject unsafe or invalid plans cleanly.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bounded PLAN_INVALID response and no action.
scenarios.verification: Assert status, journal category and zero actions.

scenarios.title: Refused confirmation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Goal pauses and no mutation occurs.
scenarios.verification: Inspect goal blocker and target absence.

scenarios.title: Expired confirmation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request is rejected and no action runs.
scenarios.verification: Assert 409-safe error and unchanged target.

scenarios.title: Rollback after failed verification
scenarios.purpose: Restore reversible mutation on verification failure.
scenarios.trigger: Approve a write whose verification must fail.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Goal blocks and original state is restored.
scenarios.verification: Inspect filesystem plus transaction state.

scenarios.title: Pause and resume goal
scenarios.expected_outcome: Execution continues at current step.
scenarios.verification: Compare checkpoint and action IDs.

scenarios.title: Restart during paused goal
scenarios.expected_outcome: Completed steps are not replayed.
scenarios.verification: Reopen store and compare checkpoints/actions.

scenarios.title: Completed goal not replayed after restart
scenarios.expected_outcome: Completed goal is absent from resumable set.
scenarios.verification: Query store and assert no new actions.

scenarios.title: UIA inspect action verify
scenarios.expected_outcome: Semantic evidence verifies the intended change.
scenarios.verification: Compare before/after UIA properties.

scenarios.title: Stale window reference recovery
scenarios.expected_outcome: Nova re-observes and replans or blocks safely.
scenarios.verification: Assert discovery precedes any action with new reference.

scenarios.title: Provider unavailable then fallback
scenarios.expected_outcome: Fallback succeeds within route budget.
scenarios.verification: Inspect sanitized route diagnostics.

scenarios.title: No structured planner provider
scenarios.expected_outcome: NO_STRUCTURED_PLANNER_PROVIDER and zero actions.
scenarios.verification: Assert public error category and journal.

scenarios.title: Visual provider unavailable cleanly
scenarios.purpose: Keep visual degradation explicit and safe.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sanitized unavailable result; no fabricated observation.
scenarios.verification: Assert error category and absence of claimed findings.

scenarios.title: Cancel active goal
scenarios.purpose: Stop bounded work and expose cancellation consistently.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Goal and UI reach cancelled; no later replay.
scenarios.verification: Inspect goal, journal and state endpoint.

scenarios.title: Terminal state synchronization
scenarios.purpose: Keep conversation card and presence panel aligned.
scenarios.trigger: Approve to completion, then repeat with blocked, failed and cancelled fixtures.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Presence derives each authoritative terminal state and clears confirmation.
scenarios.verification: Compare goal response, /state, conversation card and presence label.
